narration.text: You've got a story in your head, and this marketplace agent can make it visible, panel by panel.
Text-only writing tools stall at long descriptions, because a comic still needs actual artwork drawn on every single page.
With BoredComic, one idea leads to finished comic pages, complete with storyboard, dialogue, and panel art drawn for you.
You describe the genre, the scenario, and the cast; it storyboards every page, then draws panel-by-panel artwork in that order.
Basic costs fifty cents, one to five pages; standard one dollar, six to ten; premium three dollars, eleven to twenty; tools revise pages or register characters.
Open the OKX dot AI marketplace, choose BoredComic, and start with a simple prompt to see your own comic pages.
